narration: Knowing where invention happens is far better. It happens in one specific kind of slot.
caption: बेहतर है जानना कि गढ़ंत कहाँ होती है। वह एक ख़ास जगह पर होती है।
image_brief: A printed form on a clipboard where every field is filled except one narrow blank box outlined in red, a pen lying across the clipboard, warm desk light.

narration: By the end, you will know exactly what the machine computes at each step.
caption: आख़िर तक आप जान जाएंगे कि मशीन हर चरण पर क्या हिसाब लगाती है।
image_brief: A cross-section diagram sketched in pencil on graph paper, an arrow entering a plain box and a column of scores leaving it, a ruler and eraser beside, cool light.

narration: You will know why one changed word can change an entire answer. Not soften it.
caption: आप समझेंगे कि एक शब्द बदलने से पूरा जवाब क्यों बदल जाता है।
image_brief: Two printed prompt lines stacked on white paper, identical except one word in the lower line boxed in ink, a wide empty space below both lines, soft light.

narration: You will know which slot in a sentence quietly invites invention. It is predictable.
caption: आप पहचानेंगे कि वाक्य की कौन सी जगह गढ़ंत को न्योता देती है।
image_brief: A sentence printed on a long strip of card with one word cut clean out, leaving a rectangular hole through which the dark table surface shows, angled light.

narration: And a sixty second check that catches most of the damage. That is the whole promise.
caption: और एक साठ सेकंड की जाँच, जो ज़्यादातर गड़बड़ पकड़ लेती है।
image_brief: A small kitchen timer set near one minute standing on a stack of two printed pages, a pencil resting alongside, plain tabletop, bright even light.

narration: One question runs underneath all of it. Why fluent and wrong at the same time?
caption: इसके नीचे एक सवाल है: बहाव और ग़लती साथ-साथ क्यों होती हैं?
image_brief: A single question mark pressed into thick cream paper as a deep blind emboss with no ink, lit from one low angle so only its shadow reveals the shape.

narration: Start with the text itself. A model never sees letters as letters. Not once.
caption: शुरुआत लिखाई से। मॉडल अक्षरों को अक्षर की तरह कभी नहीं देखता।
image_brief: Metal letterpress type pieces spilled across a workbench, each block turned face down so no letter is visible, only blank metal backs, hard workshop light.

narration: Text gets chopped into pieces called tokens. Some are whole common words, nothing stranger.
caption: लिखाई टुकड़ों में कटती है, जिन्हें टोकन कहते हैं। कुछ पूरे शब्द होते हैं।
image_brief: A paper sentence physically cut apart with scissors into uneven fragments laid out in order on a green cutting mat, the scissors open beside them, cool bright light.

narration: Others are fragments. Un. Break. Able. Sometimes a single space, or half a name.
caption: बाक़ी टुकड़े अधूरे होते हैं: अन, ब्रेक, एबल, या बस एक ख़ाली जगह।
image_brief: Three small paper fragments held apart on dark felt, each bearing part of one long word, a narrow gap between them, one blank fragment at the end, soft top light.

narration: Each token carries an id number. So your sentence becomes a plain list of numbers.
caption: हर टोकन का एक नंबर होता है। इसलिए वाक्य नंबरों की सूची बन जाता है।
image_brief: A handwritten column of numbers on lined paper beside a torn strip of printed words, thin pencil lines pairing each word fragment to one number, desk lamp light.

narration: Numbers can be compared, measured and nudged. Letters cannot. That is the entire reason.
caption: नंबरों को नापा और बदला जा सकता है, अक्षरों को नहीं। बात यही है।
image_brief: A pair of brass weighing scales on a stone counter, small numbered brass discs in one pan and a crumpled paper word in the other, the pans hanging unevenly, warm light.

narration: Each id then maps to a long row of numbers. Treat it as coordinates.
caption: फिर हर नंबर एक लंबी नंबर-पंक्ति बनता है। उसे एक पता समझ लीजिए।
image_brief: A folded paper map spread open on a table with a single pin pushed through one point, faint grid lines and no place names printed anywhere, low afternoon light.

narration: Picture a vast map where related meanings sit close together. Rivers near lakes. Grief near loss.
caption: एक बड़े नक़्शे जैसा, जहाँ मिलते-जुलते अर्थ पास-पास बैठते हैं।
image_brief: A dense cluster of pins pushed into a large blank wall chart, tight groups in some regions and empty stretches between them, no string between pins, even gallery light.

narration: Nobody drew that map by hand. Training pushed every point into its position, slowly.
caption: यह नक़्शा किसी ने हाथ से नहीं बनाया। प्रशिक्षण ने हर बिंदु जमाया।
image_brief: A half-arranged wall chart of pins, several pins lying loose on the floor below it, faint old holes visible where pins were moved earlier, dim work light.

narration: Training is one exercise, repeated. Hide the next token. Guess it. Check it. Repeat.
caption: प्रशिक्षण एक ही कसरत है: अगला टोकन छिपाओ, अंदाज़ा लगाओ, जाँचो, दोहराओ।
image_brief: A flashcard face down on a desk beside an identical card standing upright with its blank back showing, a tally of pencil marks on scrap paper nearby, plain light.
